messages:
Maya: Hey team — quick Q for presales. ZenithBank POC needs strict EU-only data residency for customer data and wants BYO-KMS. Can we confirm: 1) which subprocessors touch customer data in EU mode? 2) does control plane metadata route via US control plane or stay in EU? 3) any SLA/pricing delta for regional pinning? Need RFI back to customer by EOD.

Oliver: Do they mean data plane only or also control plane? Also is BYO-KMS HSM or KMS? Those change answers.

Maya: BYO-KMS via customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS) — HSM not required for initial POC. They care about control plane latency but legal says no control-plane egress from EU.

Samir: Short answers from infra: we support tenant pinning to EU regions (eu-west1, eu-central1). In pinned mode: data-plane and KV caches stay in region; control plane signaling still goes to our control plane unless they opt for Private (VPC) deployment. Fallback policy: if pinned region unavailable we can fail requests (configurable) or route to a verified secondary EU region. We do NOT route to US for pinned tenants unless explicitly allowed.

Samir: Config snippet for the POC (ops):
```yaml
tenant_routing:
  mode: pinned
  primary_region: eu-west1
  failover: eu-central1
  control_plane: hosted-eu
  byo_kms: true
```

Nora: Security note — BYO-KMS accepted. For hosted BYO we support customer CMK via KMS with envelope encryption. We need customer to provide key grants + key rotation window. Subprocessor list for EU pinned tenants: cloud provider (encrypted volumes), logging/monitoring (only metadata), optional metrics aggregator (we can disable). I'll attach the current subproc CSV. Link: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors

security-bot: Added subprocessor CSV to thread. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Pricing/ SLA impact? Customer asking for monthly delta for EU pin + BYO.

Nora: Presales estimate: EU pin + BYO add-on = +25% on token price (min $3k/mo for POC), additional compliance review 1-2 weeks. If they require private control plane -> that's enterprise contract + infra costs.

Oliver: Ops note — if they want no control-plane egress we should propose Private deployment (VPC) or control-plane-in-eu which requires legal approval. Timeline-wise POC can start in 2 weeks with hosted pinned deployment and BYO-KMS if they give ok on key grants.

Maya: OK I'll send RFI back to customer summarizing: hosted EU-pinned with BYO-KMS, no US egress, +25% pricing ballpark, 2wk setup. Tagging @Nora for final language for RFI. Thanks!

Nora: I'll draft short RFI blurb. Will post in next 30m.

Samir: I'll prep ops runbook for the pin + failover and share after Nora's blurb.
